svg.text: Archetype C — Detail Overview · layout blueprint (v2.0 · v2.1 rail panel below)
One resolved entity, vertical stack: master data → aggregates → transactional data. Everything below the header is a bounded section. Omit slots — never reorder.

g.text: DETAILS
Recent activity
In-context widget (island)
Resources
1 · header — slot: header
Title text-lg font-semibold, left. Subtitle text-xs muted below.
Actions ALWAYS a right-aligned row — never mixed into the title
line. No breadcrumbs (app shell owns them). Omit the slot when a
parent layout renders the title (Mode B).
2 · master data — slot: summary
What this entity IS. A DetailSection ("Details") of ruled ledger
rows: label left (sm muted), value right (sm medium, tabular),
hairline dividers. Chip attributes are master data — a row with
right-justified badges, never a floating section. Long free-text
uses a stacked block row. Section actions right-aligned in the
overline title bar. Empty values render "—", never blank.
3 · aggregates — slot: stats
How it's doing: ONE flat strip, 2–4 cells, internal hairlines —
never separate mini-cards. Overline label, value text-2xl
semibold tabular, "—" when missing. Collapses to a stacked
column on narrow viewports.
4 · transactional data — slot: content
What happened: embedded read-only lists/tables, then read-write
islands — each its own DetailSection. Embedded tables use the
shared table primitive, read-only config (no row actions, no
row-click nav). Section actions right-aligned in the title row —
same rule everywhere.
5 · reference panels — slot: references
Cross-entity links, related records, external resources. Always
last, in a DetailSection with tone="muted" — the page's lightest
surface. Graded weights: shadowed data → flat strip → muted refs.
Page-wide rules:
everything below the header is a bounded DetailSection — naked sections are the defining anti-pattern · no toolbar, no pagination · omit slots, never reorder.

svg.text: Command Rail variant — layout="rail" · lg+ placement
The SAME ordered slots placed in 2D: sticky identity rail (summary + references) beside a scrolling main column (stats + content).
Recommended pairing: surface="unified" — one bounded frame on the muted page mat.

g.text: Recent activity
In-context widget (island)
1 · header — full-width across the frame
Spans rail + main. In surface="unified" this bar follows the
--header-fill contract (solid default: accent fill, inverted
actions; tint / white are the quieter steps).
2 + 5 · identity rail — aside, ~300px, lg:sticky top-6
summary on top — may lead with the compact metric readout
(MetricList: ruled label/value rows + "show more" disclosure);
references pinned at the rail's bottom. In unified the rail is
CHROMELESS — flush, hairline-divided (UnifiedSurfaceContext) —
never carded. The rail is sticky, NEVER its own scroll region.
3 + 4 · main column — stats, then content
Stats strip may be OMITTED when its 2–4 metrics surface in the
rail readout instead (recommended — avoids duplication).
Content sections keep declaration order; inside the unified
frame they render flattened (no shadow, softer border).
Responsive collapse (the compliance keystone)
Below lg the rail collapses to Panel 1 EXACTLY — the canonical
vertical order header → summary → stats → content → references.
Reading order preserved: rail top→bottom, then main. Same
archetype, not a fork — no second scroll container, ever.
Rail rules:
sanctioned two-column layout ONLY via layout="rail" — ad-hoc sidebars and hand-rolled columns stay forbidden · use for dense transactional
records (orders, deals, invoices); otherwise stay vertical · recommended pairing: layout="rail" surface="unified".
